notes.title: A Familiar World v1.0.0
notes.content:
As a small apology to everyone who was waiting for a new update, I added a couple of extra puzzles that are sort of out of contention. They don't unlock new scenes, but they feature the girls. I turned some of the promo images I created over the year into puzzles. 

After that, I added some of the better renders from A Foreign World. I also turned them into puzzles. Again, they don't unlock scenes, but if you can enjoy a good puzzle (and I know there aren't that many people who do), you can now enjoy this game a bit longer.


In its final build, we have 101 puzzles. 44 will unlock scenes, and the rest can be enjoyed if the 44 didn't satisfy your thirst for puzzles.

- 4 new puzzles
- 3 new scenes
- 65 new puzzles that can be enjoyed apart from the actual game
